title: The Broker Call
setting: Noon. Day three at the hotel and your back already misses your old mattress. Anna passed you Rangaswamy's number — "good broker sir, fast." The phone rings on the second try. You hear honking through it before he says hello.

beats.beat: his Bluetooth crackles. someone is honking near him.

choices.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. Flat ಬಗ್ಗೆ call ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೆ. Anna ಕೊಟ್ಟರು ನಿಮ್ಮ number.
choices.translit: namaskāra. flat baggē call māḍidde. Anna koṭṭaru nimma number.
choices.en: Hello. I'm calling about a flat. Anna gave me your number.
Hi, calling about the Indiranagar flat.

beats.native: Oh, ಹೌದು ಹೌದು ಸಾರ್. Indiranagar 2BHK. ಸೂಪರ್ flat. Fully furnished. ಮುಂದೆ ಮೆಟ್ರೋ.
beats.translit: oh, haudu haudu sār. Indiranagar 2BHK. super flat. fully furnished. munde metro.
beats.en: Oh yes yes sir. Indiranagar 2BHK. Super flat. Fully furnished. Metro right in front.
beats.beat: the honking gets louder — he's walking somewhere fast

beats.native: Twenty-five thousand monthly. Ten months advance. Ready to move in, ಸಾರ್.
beats.translit: twenty-five thousand monthly. ten months advance. ready to move in, sār.
beats.en: Twenty-five thousand a month. Ten months advance. Ready to move in, sir.

choices.native: ಹತ್ತು months advance ತುಂಬಾ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ. Two months ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ?
choices.translit: hattu months advance tumbā jāsti. two months-nalli āguttā?
choices.en: Ten months advance is too much. Can we do two?

choices.native: Fully furnished ಅಂದ್ರೆ exact ಏನು ಇದೆ ಸಾರ್?
choices.translit: fully furnished andre exact ēnu ide sār?
choices.en: When you say 'fully furnished' — what exactly is in there?
Okay, sounds good. Let me come see it.

beats.native: Sir sir sir. ಎಲ್ಲಾ owners ten months ಕೇಳ್ತಾರೆ. Okay, six months ಆದ್ರೆ. ಬೇರೆ ಯಾವುದೇ negotiation ಇಲ್ಲ ಸಾರ್.
beats.translit: sir sir sir. ellā owners ten months kēḷtāre. okay, six months ādre. bēre yāvudē negotiation illa sār.
beats.en: Sir sir sir. All owners ask for ten months. Okay, six months if you must. No other negotiations, sir.
beats.beat: he's already moving you to a yes — the no is half-hearted

beats.native: ನೋಡಿ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಸಾರ್, ನಿಮಗೆ ಇಷ್ಟ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. Today evening 6 o'clock ಬರ್ರೀ. ನಾನು ಬಂದು meet ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
beats.translit: nōḍi omme sār, nimage iṣṭa āgutte. today evening 6 o'clock barrī. nānu bandu meet māḍtīni.
beats.en: Just come see it once, sir, you'll love it. Today evening 6 o'clock, come. I'll meet you there.
beats.beat: the honking has stopped. he's standing still for the first time on this call.

choices.native: ಸರಿ. ಆರು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಬರ್ತೀನಿ. Address WhatsApp ಗೆ send ಮಾಡಿ.
choices.translit: sari. āru gaṇṭege bartīni. address WhatsApp-ge send māḍi.
choices.en: Okay. I'll come at six. WhatsApp me the address.

choices.native: ಬೇರೆ ಒಂದು flat ಕೂಡ ತೋರಿಸಿ ಸಾರ್. ಒಂದು ಮಾತ್ರ enough ಇಲ್ಲ.
choices.translit: bēre ondu flat kūḍa tōrisi sār. ondu mātra enough illa.
choices.en: Show me another flat too, sir. One isn't enough.
Let me think about it. I'll call back.

beats.native: Done ಸಾರ್. Address ಬರ್ತಾ ಇದೆ. Bye!
beats.translit: done sār. address bartā ide. bye!
beats.en: Done, sir. Address is coming. Bye!
beats.beat: he's already on the next call before the line cuts
